# Organisation: what a company is

> What a company is, as an organisation: the functions it must perform (economic, legal, technical, human), the roles and structure that perform them, its description as an information-processing system, and how it adapts. The first review is written, a first pass of 64 sources ending on the baseline B1.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Organisation: what a company is](https://tewf.github.io/business-organization-design/README.md): the scope, what the review found and the baseline
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/business-organization-design/evidence/README.md): the review and the bibliography
- [Organisation design review](https://tewf.github.io/business-organization-design/evidence/organisation-design/README.md): frame, protocol, sources, review, state of the art, position, against and the baseline B1
- [Organisation description](https://tewf.github.io/business-organization-design/shapes/organisation-description.md): accepted, B1's table for one organisation, with a fixture and the check that reads it
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-organization-design/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business-organization-design/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
